description: This file is a shell library and test script providing functions to manage a git daemon for testing purposes. It includes functions to start and stop the git daemon, configure network connections, and check prerequisites, primarily used for testing the git implementation.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts the git daemon with specific configuration, manages PID files, and ensures readiness before proceeding.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon process and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: Imitates a netcat client, establishing a socket connection to a specified host:port, sending data, and receiving a response.
